info.name: Student Management System (FastAPI microservices)
info.description: Flow-style collection covering every endpoint family through the API gateway. Set adminPassword in the environment, then run the collection top to bottom.

item.name: 00 Gateway & health
item.description: Public endpoints. The first request's pre-script generates unique names for this run.

exec: pm.test("overall status UP", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === 'UP').to.be.ok; });
pm.test("has paths", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(j.paths).length > 20).to.be.ok; });
pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'UNAUTHORIZED').to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('studentUserId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save studentUserId', e); }
pm.test("role is STUDENT", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.roles[0] === 'STUDENT').to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', String(j.access_token)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save accessToken', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', String(j.refresh_token)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save refreshToken', e); }
pm.test("bearer token pair", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token_type === 'bearer' && j.refresh_token).to.be.ok; });

request.description: Stores accessToken/refreshToken; every other request uses {{accessToken}} via collection-level Bearer auth.

exec: pm.test("scope narrowed", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.scope === 'courses:read students:read').to.be.ok; });

request.description: RFC 6749 §4.3. The returned token only carries the requested scopes.

exec: pm.test("is admin", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.roles.indexOf('ADMIN') >= 0).to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', String(j.access_token)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save accessToken', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', String(j.refresh_token)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save refreshToken', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('studentToken', String(j.access_token)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save studentToken', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('studentRefresh', String(j.refresh_token)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save studentRefresh', e); }

item.name: Reset password with an invalid token -> 400

exec: try { pm.collectionVariables.set('teacherId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save teacherId', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('deptId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save deptId', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('studentId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save studentId', e); }
pm.test("student number generated", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(/^STU\d{10}$/.test(j.student_number)).to.be.ok; });

item.name: Link a student record to the registered user (for self-service)

exec: try { pm.collectionVariables.set('selfStudentId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save selfStudentId', e); }
pm.test("eager-loaded relations", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.profile && j.contacts.length === 1 && j.interests.length === 2).to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('contactId', String(j.contacts[j.contacts.length-1].id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save contactId', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('bulkId', String(j[0].id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save bulkId', e); }
pm.test("linked to my user id", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user_id > 0).to.be.ok; });
pm.test("no filesystem path leaks", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(!JSON.stringify(j).includes('/home')).to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('fileId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save fileId', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('categoryId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save categoryId', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('courseId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save courseId', e); }
pm.test("available", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.is_available === true && j.available_seats === 30).to.be.ok; });
pm.test("teacher assigned", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.teachers.length === 1).to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('courseFileId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save courseFileId', e); }

item.name: Enroll student (REST validation of student + course)

exec: try { pm.collectionVariables.set('enrollmentId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save enrollmentId', e); }
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('selfEnrollmentId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save selfEnrollmentId', e); }
pm.test("cancelled", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === 'CANCELLED').to.be.ok; });
pm.test("completed", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === 'COMPLETED').to.be.ok; });
try { pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationId', String(j.id)); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save notificationId', e); }
pm.test('status is one of [204, 409]', function () { pm.expect([204, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Revoked token is rejected -> 401 (after Kafka propagation)

exec: pm.test('status is one of [200, 401]', function () { pm.expect([200, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: The gateway learns about the revocation through the TokenRevoked Kafka event; usually < 1 s.
